title: ITER_1D neutron flux and absorption by material cell (code-to-code reference exercise)

license.attribution: ITER_1D inputs from IAEA-NDS/open-benchmarks (IAEA Nuclear Data Section), CC BY 4.0. No upstream file is copied into this repository; identities are hashes.
license.terms: CC BY 4.0, per upstream repository LICENSE

normalisation.quantity: volume-average neutron flux and absorption rate per material cell
normalisation.units: flux: particle/cm2 per source neutron; absorption: reactions/cm3 per source neutron
normalisation.source_normalisation: per source neutron, unit-weight sites, 14.056 MeV normal source in void cell 51
normalisation.location: 97 material-filled cells (concentric z-cylinder annuli, exact analytic volumes)
normalisation.reaction_or_particle: neutron; absorption scored analog, flux track-length

components.name: Monte Carlo sampling of the calculation

uncertainty.note: No reference response set is registered, so no reference uncertainty exists yet.

compatibility.k_basis: authored: coverage factor 2 on the combined standard uncertainty

covariance.basis: no second code has been run; correlation between the two codes' results (same nuclear data, same source law) is not characterised

neutron_flux.description: track-length flux averaged over each material cell

neutron_absorption.description: analog absorption rate density in each material cell

detectors.reference_missing_why: no provenance-qualified reference response set exists for ITER_1D (references/iter-1d-reference.json comparison status NOT_EVALUATED)
detectors.reference_missing_next_step: obtain a reference run of a second code (MCNP or Serpent inputs exist upstream) or recover the producing inputs of the JADE statepoint, then add reference values with uncertainties

detectors.reference_missing_why: no provenance-qualified reference response set exists for ITER_1D (references/iter-1d-reference.json comparison status NOT_EVALUATED)
detectors.reference_missing_next_step: obtain a reference run of a second code (MCNP or Serpent inputs exist upstream) or recover the producing inputs of the JADE statepoint, then add reference values with uncertainties

not_covered: any experimental comparison: ITER_1D is a computational benchmark, so agreement is verification evidence only and shares nuclear data and geometry with the reference code
photon transport, nuclear heating and activation (the registered control is neutron-only)
three-dimensional effects, ports and streaming (one-dimensional cylindrical model)

materials: ITER bulk shield and vacuum vessel region materials as in the benchmark (97 material cells)
qualified_range.geometry_class: one-dimensional concentric cylinder, reflective at z = +/-1000 cm, outer vacuum radius 1389.5 cm
qualified_range.spectrum_class: 14.06 MeV D-T line source (normal, sigma 0.24 MeV) with moderated spectrum behind the first wall
